#load data and sample info
```{r}
#load wax data
wax.data <- read.csv("data/surface_area_data.csv", header=TRUE)

# Sample IDs used to validate plate map labels
sample_ids <- read.csv("data/master_sample_info.csv")

# Surface area data
sa <- read.csv("output/surface_area_calculated.csv")

# Tissue homogenate volume data 
homog_vols <- read.csv("data/homogenate_vols.csv") 

```

1ml of sample was taken from the homogenate
Neubauer improved hemocytometer chamber with an area of 1 mm² and depth of 0.1 mm:
Cells per mL

Each photo covers one 1 mm² square x 0.1 mm depth = 10^-4 mL. Each replicate count (Count1-4) consists of up to 4 photos (photo1-4), which are summed within the count:

cells/mL for a count = (sum of cells across photos / (number of photos X 10^-4 mL)) X Dilution factor

cells/mL for a colony = mean of the cells/mL values across the replicate counts

CV (%) = SD / mean of the replicate-count cells/mL values X 100

total cells = cells/mL X homogenate volume in mL

cells normalized to surface area = total cells/cm2

# Check for duplicate colony_id
```{r}
# Raw hemocytometer counts: one row per replicate count (Count1-4), photo1-4 columns
sym.counts <- read.csv("data/sym_counts_data.csv")

# Each colony_id + CountNumber should appear once
dup_counts <- sym.counts |>
  count(colony_id, CountNumber) |>
  filter(n > 1)

if (nrow(dup_counts) > 0) {
  print(dup_counts)
  stop("Duplicate colony_id + CountNumber rows in sym_counts_data.csv")
} else {
  cat("No duplicate colony_id + CountNumber rows in counts.\n")
}

# Each colony should have 4 replicate counts
sym.counts |>
  count(colony_id) |>
  filter(n != 4) |>
  print()

# Duplicate colony_id in the lookup tables would multiply rows when joining
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(homog_vols$colony_id), !anyDuplicated(sa$colony_id))
```

```{r}
photo_vol_ml <- 1e-4  # volume counted in each photo (1 mm2 x 0.1 mm)
dilution_factor <- 1  # set to the actual dilution used (not recorded in the data file)
cv_threshold <- 15    # flag colonies with CV (%) above this

# Sum photos within each replicate count and convert to cells/mL
sym.count.totals <- sym.counts |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(
    n_photos = sum(!is.na(c_across(matches("^photo[1-4]$")))),
    count_total = sum(c_across(matches("^photo[1-4]$")), na.rm = TRUE),
    cells_per_ml = count_total / (n_photos * photo_vol_ml) * dilution_factor
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(colony_id, CountNumber, n_photos, count_total, cells_per_ml)

# Mean, SD and CV of cells/mL across the replicate counts for each colony
sym.density <- sym.count.totals |>
  group_by(colony_id) |>
  summarise(
    n_counts = n(),
    min_photos = min(n_photos),
    sd_cells_per_ml = sd(cells_per_ml),
    cells_per_ml = mean(cells_per_ml),
    cv_percent = sd_cells_per_ml / cells_per_ml * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    cv_flag = cv_percent > cv_threshold,
    incomplete = n_counts != 4 | min_photos != 4
  )

sym.density
```

```{r}
# Total cells per colony and normalization to surface area
sym.norm <- sym.density |>
  left_join(homog_vols, by = "colony_id") |>
  left_join(select(sa, colony_id, surface.area.cm2), by = "colony_id") |>
  mutate(
    total_cells = cells_per_ml * homog_vol_ml,
    cells_per_cm2 = total_cells / surface.area.cm2
  )

# Every colony should have a homogenate volume and surface area
stopifnot(!anyNA(sym.norm$homog_vol_ml), !anyNA(sym.norm$surface.area.cm2))
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(sym.norm$colony_id))

write.csv(sym.norm, "output/symbiont_density.csv", row.names = FALSE)

sym.norm
```

# Plot by genus and site
```{r}
sym.plot.data <- sym.norm |>
  left_join(select(sample_ids, colony_id, genus, site), by = "colony_id") |>
  filter(!is.na(genus))

dodge <- position_dodge(width = 0.5)

ggplot(sym.plot.data, aes(x = genus, y = cells_per_cm2 / 1e6, color = site, group = site)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3, size = 1,
             position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.05, dodge.width = 0.5)) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "line", position = dodge) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", position = dodge) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = mean_se, geom = "errorbar", width = 0.1, position = dodge) +
  labs(x = "Genus", y = expression("Symbiont cells (10"^6*" cm"^-2*")"), color = "Site") +
  theme_bw()

ggsave("output/symbiont_density_by_genus_site.pdf", width = 8, height = 5)
```
